flows.name: Daily deep read with authoritative project identity
steps: Enumerate the prior business day's complete source corpus
Resolve project identity from SharePoint proposal and estimate folders
Synthesize and validate the detailed and structured reports
Persist the packet and read back every required consumer
flows.expectedOutcome: The current packet is complete, source-linked, and contains no cross-project attribution

claims.description: Proposal and estimate folders are mandatory attribution evidence before synthesis
Unsupported or cross-project citations stop publication
The accepted deep read is fresh, current, complete, and persisted with consumer readbacks
Space Coast is preserved as its own source identity and Port contamination is zero
